items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: It was his band, just a little group about five, six. And he wrote these real complex arrangements.

ctx.x: It was his band, just a little group about five, six. And he wrote these real complex arrangements. We only — maybe one number we had, but it was really hard, and you had to really read it and we’d go in and rehearse and then we’d have like about two or three hours off before the show. I remember I’d come back to the show it was like I’d never seen this music before.
And it was live of course, right?
